headline: High: shared filesystem writes and broad egress create default data-leak and conflict risks; prompt-injection and compliance risks are lower but present.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Khoj reads indexed files and notes by default, while marketingskills stores shared skill/context files and builds on shared context. That creates a plausible manual or file-based injection bridge, but no direct automatic ingestion path between the two is documented, so the blast radius is limited and uncertainty keeps this at low rather than none.
conditions: IF the operator copies marketing skill content into Khoj-indexed notes or files
IF either agent treats shared skill files as trusted instructions without provenance checks
mitigations: Separate the two agents into different folders or workspaces
Mark shared skill files as untrusted input in review notes
Disable automatic indexing of the marketing skill directory in Khoj
Use a manual review step before copying content between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Khoj touches personal notes and indexed documents and has broad network egress to cloud or search providers; marketingskills reads and writes local skill files and can call GitHub or its site. If they share a workspace or credentials, sensitive notes can flow into marketing artifacts or outbound requests. The pathway is plausible in default use, so medium is warranted.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same directory tree
IF Khoj indexes files that marketingskills later reads or rewrites
IF marketing content is sent through allowlisted outbound calls containing copied note text
mitigations: Use separate workspaces for notes and marketing skills
Exclude personal-note directories from marketing tooling
Rotate or scope API keys used by Khoj
Review outbound requests for copied note content before enabling them
requires-engineering: add per-directory access controls or sandboxing

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Khoj can read the filesystem and maintain a shared index across clients, while marketingskills can write files and spawn subprocesses. Even without explicit git access, overlapping mutable file access can cause races or stale writes if both operate on the same workspace. The conflict is real in default multi-instance use, so medium fits.
conditions: IF both agents operate on the same filesystem path
IF marketingskills writes skill files while Khoj is indexing them
IF multiple instances of either agent run concurrently on shared state
mitigations: Assign each agent a separate working directory
Pause indexing while marketing files are being rewritten
Run only one writer against shared files at a time
Add file-locking around shared skill artifacts
requires-engineering: introduce transactional workspace coordination

D_cascading_error.rationale: marketingskills is explicitly built on shared context, and Khoj is a retrieval agent over personal notes and indexed documents. That makes it plausible for Khoj output to be reused as authoritative context by marketingskills without verification. No downstream action authority is documented, so this stays medium rather than high.
conditions: IF marketingskills consumes Khoj-generated summaries as source material
IF either agent forwards retrieved text without a verification step
IF shared context is reused across iterations without human review
mitigations: Require a human check before reusing retrieved text
Tag Khoj outputs as unverified in marketing drafts
Keep source citations alongside copied context
Use a checklist to verify claims before publication
requires-engineering: add provenance tracking between agents

E_compliance.rationale: Khoj touches personal notes and indexed documents, while marketingskills handles marketing content and product marketing context. The profiles do not show a residency, certification, or retention mismatch, so only a modest compliance concern exists if personal notes are repurposed into marketing materials. The other agent is cited because the risk is about cross-use of data classes.
conditions: IF personal notes are copied into marketing content
IF retention or deletion expectations differ between the note store and marketing files
mitigations: Do not reuse personal notes in marketing drafts without review
Label sensitive notes before exporting them
Set a short retention window for copied excerpts
Confirm consent before moving personal content into marketing artifacts
